title: Hello World (LangChain)
summary: Step 1 again, same rules and same replies, rebuilt as a LangChain chain: a RunnableLambda to clean the input, then a RunnableBranch to pick the rule.
learn: LangChain's core idea: small Runnables joined with .pipe() into a chain you call with .invoke()
RunnableBranch: if/else as a chain step (is empty? → is greeting? → fallback)
streamEvents(): LangChain reports every step as it runs, which drives the street view and the diagram below
next: Step 4 runs this same chain in Python on a server (FastAPI), the setup every later agent step builds on.
